events.headline: WHAT WE KNOW ABOUT THE US CAPTURE OF IRANIAN VESSEL NEAR HORMUZ
events.detail: US releases video showing the capture of Iranian-flagged ship near Hormuz, Trump says it tried to breach its blockade.

events.headline: US RELEASES VIDEO OF FORCES SEIZING IRANIAN SHIP
events.detail: The US has intercepted an Iranian-flagged cargo ship in the Gulf as part of its naval blockade, Donald Trump has said.

events.headline: US NAVY FIRES AT AND BOARDS IRANIAN-FLAGGED CARGO SHIP (VIDEOS)
events.detail: US Central Command has released a video of an American destroyer firing at an Iranian cargo ship near the Strait of Hormuz Read Full Article at RT.com

events.headline: TEHRAN WILL NEVER CEDE CONTROL OF STRAIT OF HORMUZ, SENIOR IRANIAN POLITICIAN TE
events.detail: Lyse Doucet speaks to Ebrahim Azizi, who says Iran "will decide the right of passage" through the crucial shipping route.

events.headline: US SEIZES IRANIAN-FLAGGED CARGO SHIP – TRUMP
events.detail: The US has seized an Iranian-flagged vessel in Gulf of Oman amid the naval blockade of Iran, President Donald Trump has announced Read Full Article at RT.com

events.headline: TRUMP RETOMA LAS NEGOCIACIONES, PERO AMENAZA CON HACER “VOLAR IRÁN POR LOS AIRES
events.detail: El presidente estadounidense envía a Vance, Witkoff y Kushner a Pakistán para reanudar el lunes las conversaciones de paz. Teherán no acudirá mientras prosiga el “bloqueo naval”
